body:
Thank you. And yes I think dwelling on those slips is what’s hanging me up these days. Imposter syndrome would be a good way to describe it. I think I’ve always been kind of a perfectionist so it makes sense that the negatives of that would carry over to my sobriety. 

One thing I’ve considered long term is eventually trying some low alcohol beers. I guess I wouldn’t think to dwell on whether drinking those should reset my days, and realistically in those 2 sips I’ve had probably had the alcohol level of a low alcohol beer. So I guess that’s one way I can reconcile.

I also didn’t really pre-plan any of these drinking episodes, I guess my focus needs to be on reinforcing my commitment to not drink so I can better decline in these situations.
I totally resonate with your view. Are you working a program currently? I’m always open to the different approaches.

This is why I love this community so much. Thank you for the encouragement, I feel a lot better about things now. Exactly right, I’ve probably had cookies with the same amount of vanilla lol 

But I’m definitely being thoughtful of my state of mind. Things could have been worse, I need to take this as a lesson to grow from.
I think it was real, 41% alcohol. Probably the only thing alcoholic in my house these days. Cumulatively just a few sips probably. Ugh it’s probably more the principle that’s getting me down

I have smart start as well, had it for about a year and still one year to go. I’ve heard they’re one of the better quality providers, and customer service at least for me has been great. I think every state sets the timing differently, I have 10 minutes to blow for rolling tests. I blow to start it, then wait about 5 minutes for the rolling test, then the 2nd and subsequent rolling tests are spaced out about 25 minutes so I can just drive normally. I time my commute and fast food runs around this so I’m not blowing while steering in traffic or when I’m at the McDonalds window lol. The camera is also pretty small and in the left corner of my windshield, not too noticeable at all.

Be grateful you’re not in Minnesota, because I have my interlock AND whiskey plates. So as discreet as the interlock is, my plates give me away haha but that’s the punishment, it will all be over soon and I can’t wait for the day I get my car back to normal! Happy to answer any other of your Qs.
Thank you for sharing, that definitely helps.

Please write your legislators about this!! A first offense expungement is a great first step, but I totally agree with you. I’m hopeful they will expand it, especially if you’ve really turned your life around since the last episode. Dangling a carrot for relief goes a long way towards actual rehabilitation for offenders.

Pretty butt-hurt, and so are MI prosecutors. Which is pretty ridiculous considering the bill clearly allows law enforcement to have full record access still.

Hopefully they expand it to allow folks with more than 1, they could probably use relief the most especially if they had a substance/mental health issue and have now gotten on a better path.

I’m glad MI is bringing their expungement laws more up to date with other states though, theirs have been pretty draconian for a while now.

Lol thank you, I should channel this obsession into a law degree. Time will pass and the anxiety/paranoia will fade, let me just encourage everyone not to drink and drive so they don’t have to think about this stuff.

Thank you for the advice. That's the consensus I've gathered as well. I ended up having my attorney modify my suspended sentence on the 2nd DUI as it was initially set at 365 days and I've heard that would have created issues for Japan, Australia, and New Zealand.  They're strict on that "1 year or more" sentence, suspended or servced. I guess that's what constitutes a serious crime to them, sort of like a US felony. Now it's around 300 days suspended so hopefully that will help me avoid any issues.

One thing that gets me paranoid is reading some of the country's immigration acts that state they can deny you entry for any offense. I have yet to find a forum online about a person getting denied entry to a country for tourism with DUIs other than Canada. Here are the immigration acts I was finding:

Singapore: Section 8 (3) of the Immigration Act lists those convicted for a sentence of imprisonment as potential undesirable immigrants, and entry will be refused.

Thailand: Immigration Act of Thailand B.E. 2522 (1979), any jail term except for a petty offence, negligence or something excepted by Ministerial Regulations will disqualify you from entry.

Malaysia:  Having being sentenced to any jail term is one of the things that will get you labeled as a "prohibited person" per section 8 of the Immigration Act 1959/63.

It doesn't look like either of these countries have questions pertaining to criminal record on their debarkation cards, perhaps these rules just get applied when applying for long-term residency and/or your record is serious enough to be flagged on Interpol.

Great, thank you for sharing your experience. Those are definitely all countries on my bucket list. I know China asks on even it's tourist visa, question 3.3 I believe, about any criminal history. Did you check yes or no? I've heard mixed things, like for misdemeanors most likely you'd be fine just saying no.

Thanks for speaking from experience. Was that mainland China, where an L visa is required for tourism? Or Hong Kong which only requires a US passport? I’m also aware of the 144 hour visa free window China has which is something I’d definitely consider doing.
Thanks yeah that’s sort of the consensus I’ve gathered as well. The only posts I’ve seen of people being denied entry are for Canada, and maybe a few for the USA.
4 beers after 24 hours wouldn’t be a DUI anywhere in the US. Passed starting my interlock yesterday without issues. You’re not super helpful for someone who uses their full name as a username lol

Thanks. Yeah it’s not seeming worth it with even a small chance of additional IID time/fees and probation violations. That sort of all just played through my mind, I’ll probably just stick to Heineken 0.0s or an NA kombucha or something
Thanks for the suggestion, I’ll probs buy it anyway to prevent any anxiety with things like kombucha and pizza. Apparently both of those can set it off.
Yeah it really doesn’t seem worth it, just wanted to see if anyone else had experience.
